parameters.query:
SELECT ra.question_id, ra.response_id, ra.option_id, qo.text AS option_label, ra.numeric_value
FROM response_answers ra
JOIN survey_responses sr ON sr.id = ra.response_id
LEFT JOIN question_options qo ON qo.id = ra.option_id
WHERE sr.survey_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND sr.status != 'FALLIDO'
